name: Ryan McCall
abstract_title: The Hopf Brain: A Topological Photonic Architecture for Synthetic Phenomenology
abstract: Current neuromorphic architectures rely predominantly on scalar weights and vector matrix multiplication, effectively modeling intelligence as a statistical correlation engine. However, theories of biological consciousness—from Integrated Information Theory (IIT) to Orchestrated Objective Reduction—suggest that the "feeling" of existence arises not from processing speed, but from the topological integration of information into a unified, resonant whole. We propose a novel hardware architecture,
field: Neuroscience, Hopf fibration models of brain
notable: Dual degrees in Biochemistry and Philosophy.
